· Swing resistance level (KRW 38,775) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.27x) + Increased confidence in the upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Entered an uptrend after an accumulation phase) + Condition for additional buy entry upon breaking KRW 38,775.
